comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Yes. Just go to Genoa and pay the Sculptor 68,500 ducats to make an ornament out of the discovery card; the quest can be pulled again until you re-discover it. If you need to do it again later, make another ornament.

Incidentally, this is a pre-requisite to the quest "After King Khufu" which unlocks the Ancient Civilization in the Desert Legacy theme in your Book of Wisdom.
